record.paper_title: Open questions for operators related to rectangular Catalan combinatorics
record.original_question: For every seed g_d and every coprime pair of positive integers a and b, prove that the elliptic Hall algebra operator Theta_{a,b}(g_d), after specialization t=1, acts on every symmetric function g(x) simply by multiplication by the fixed symmetric function g_d^(a,b)(x;q,1) = Theta_{a,b}(g_d)(1) evaluated at t=1.

evidence.quote: Question. 6. Can we prove that the operator Θa,b (gd)∣∣t=1 operates by mul-tiplication by g(a,b )

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Lambda = \Lambda(x;q,t)$ denote the ring of symmetric functions in countably many variables $x = (x_1, x_2, \ldots)$ over the field $\mathbb{Q}(q,t)$. For each coprime pair $(a,b)$ of positive integers, let $\Theta_{a,b}$ denote the corresponding operator on $\Lambda$ coming from the action of the elliptic Hall algebra on symmetric functions (so that, in particular, $\Theta_{1,0}$ acts as multiplication by a Macdonald-type generator and the family $\{\Theta_{a,b}\}$ realizes the $\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{Z})$-symmetry of the elliptic Hall algebra). For each positive integer $d$, fix a "seed" symmetric function $g_d \in \Lambda$, and write
$$ g_d^{(a,b)}(x;q,t) \;:=\; \Theta_{a,b}(g_d)(1), $$
i.e., the image of the constant symmetric function $1$ under $\Theta_{a,b}(g_d)$.

Prove or disprove: for every $d \ge 1$ and every coprime pair $(a,b)$ of positive integers, the specialization $\Theta_{a,b}(g_d)\big|_{t=1}$ acts on $\Lambda(x;q,1)$ as multiplication by the symmetric function $g_d^{(a,b)}(x;q,1)$. Equivalently, for every $g(x) \in \Lambda(x;q,1)$,
$$ \big(\Theta_{a,b}(g_d)\big|_{t=1}\big)\, g(x) \;=\; g_d^{(a,b)}(x;q,1)\cdot g(x). $$
artifact.category_tag: elliptic Hall algebra operators and symmetric functions
artifact.status_search_result: A web search surfaced active research on Theta operators, the elliptic Hall algebra action on symmetric functions, and rectangular Catalan combinatorics (e.g., work on Delta/Theta operator expansions and Murnaghan-type representations of the elliptic Hall algebra), but no source was found that explicitly establishes the claimed multiplication property of $\Theta_{a,b}(g_d)|_{t=1}$ for all seeds $g_d$ and all coprime $(a,b)$. The current status of this specific question could not be confirmed.

status_evidence.title: Delta and Theta Operator Expansions
status_evidence.snippet: Delta and Theta operators ∆_F and Θ_F for a choice of symmetric function F are fundamental symmetric function operators in the theory of Macdonald polynomials.
status_evidence.claim: Theta operators are an active object of study but the t=1 multiplication property is not stated as settled.

status_evidence.title: Murnaghan-Type Representations of the Elliptic Hall Algebra
status_evidence.snippet: Representations of the elliptic Hall algebra with bases of eigenvectors for the Macdonald element generalizing symmetric Macdonald functions.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work studies the elliptic Hall algebra action but does not appear to resolve this specific question.
